patch_description: This version replaces nonsmooth absolute-area polishing with an oriented-matroid epigraph formulation. Differential evolution first identifies a promising combinatorial orientation cell. Within that cell, every triangle orientation has a fixed sign, so the absolute determinant constraints become smooth signed quadratic inequalities. SLSQP then maximizes an explicit minimum-area variable using analytic Jacobians for all 165 triangle constraints, substantially improving local convergence and avoiding the kinked absolute-value constraints used previously.
